items.docs: Lists change controls for your Qualio instance. A change control (CC) is a formal, auditable record that documents and routes a change for review and approval â typically a change to one or more controlled documents, which appear as the change control's linked items. Each entry includes its id (e.g. CC-123), title, owner, status (`open` or `closed`), timestamps, and content sections. Supports filtering by status, ordering, and pagination.

Creates a change control for a draft document. A change control is the formal workflow record that documents and routes the proposed change for review and approval. Provide the document and the content `sections`; the section positions must match those defined by the change control template and start at position 1.
